scripts.dev:api: pnpm --filter @seatback/contracts build && pnpm --filter @seatback/chain-client build && pnpm --filter @seatback/api dev
scripts.dev:worker: pnpm --filter @seatback/contracts build && pnpm --filter @seatback/chain-client build && pnpm --filter @seatback/api build && pnpm --filter @seatback/worker dev
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @seatback/contracts build && pnpm --filter @seatback/chain-client build && pnpm --filter @seatback/api build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/migrate.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @seatback/contracts build && pnpm --filter @seatback/chain-client build && pnpm --filter @seatback/api build && pnpm --filter @seatback/worker build && pnpm --filter @seatback/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @seatback/contracts build && pnpm --filter @seatback/chain-client build && pnpm --filter @seatback/api build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @seatback/contracts build && pnpm --filter @seatback/chain-client build && pnpm --filter @seatback/api build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
